owner: Cost Estimation — original working sheets and source custody

Friendly Drive file titles are presentation labels only. Google Sheets and evidence documents remain authoritative; GitHub publishes validated derived views.

notes: The original five Google Sheet IDs did not change. File and folder names were made human-readable on 9 November 2026 without copying or moving any workbook.
Tab names, column keys, and existing formulas remain unchanged so authenticated Actions integrations keep working.
Only the Amrit rate register, Amrit measurement workbook, and Krishna Kumar Gupta payment register are currently live authenticated inputs; the two other workbooks are reference/template material.

Fishtail labour attendance, worker money and goods, site visits, and field resource records remain external. Cost Estimation may consume independently approved labour cost projections but is not their operational owner.
Individual private source Sheet IDs and payment rows are excluded from the public machine inventory; use the access-controlled Drive folder.
